mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 47 degrees with clear skies near Fireman's Park. Keep an eye on the sky for the International Space Station, which will be visible for 3 minutes starting at 5:43 PM, rising in the South over Belleville and moving toward the East over Fitchburg. The overnight low will be 36 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is moving ahead with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round accessibility, with a public information meeting set for December 8. Additionally, the city is reminding residents that Municipal Court payments for traffic citations can be handled online, by mail, or by phone to avoid unnecessary court appearances.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Pizza and a Pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out Trivia Night at The Mill, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, or ART House 360 events.
In our weekly report, we look back to October 25, when officers responded to an intersection on Plympton Street and found a 40-year-old man who was subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so head over before they close at 10:00 PM to enjoy your treat.
